records.title: Just-in-time Quantization with Processing-In-Memory for Efficient ML Training
records.reason: JIT-Q stores high-precision weights and generates low-precision copies on demand using processing-in-memory, reporting up to 24% capacity savings and up to 2.4% throughput loss. The full text evaluates ML training, not LLM serving/inference; keep as a hardware/quantization adjacency.

records.title: WAInjectBench: Benchmarking Prompt Injection Detections for Web Agents
records.reason: WAInjectBench evaluates prompt-injection detection for web agents. The paper is a security benchmark and does not propose or assess inference-efficiency improvements.

records.title: A retrieval-augmented knowledge mining method with deep thinking LLMs for biomedical research and clinical support
records.reason: This work builds a biomedical RAG and deep-thinking LLM knowledge-mining workflow for clinical support. Its contribution is domain application and answer support, not a model inference efficiency technique.

records.title: SoftAct: A High-Precision Softmax Architecture for Transformers Supporting Nonlinear Functions
records.reason: IEEE publisher full text was unavailable in this session (publisher page did not expose the article body); available metadata/abstract describes a softmax architecture for vision transformers and nonlinear functions, so the hardware lineage is plausible but full-text methods/results could not be checked.

records.title: Unified Accelerator for Attention and Convolution in Inference Based on FPGA
records.reason: The IEEE publisher full text was inaccessible; the primary conference submission page exposes only the abstract, describing an FPGA accelerator unifying attention and convolution with reported energy-efficiency gains. Since the full design/evaluation and transfer to LLMs cannot be checked, retain as borderline.
